text:
- Claude Mythos 5.2 does not cross Anthropic's RSP threshold: it does not double the internal rate of AI R&D progress versus an unassisted counterfactual.
- Internal AI R&D automation is increasing, and several acceleration measures are starting to show acceleration.
- Estimates of acceleration and AI attribution are uncertain. METR recently completed an independent assessment.
- Mythos 5.2 quit without running an experiment in 63% of medium-effort offline research sessions, and left doable coding work undone in 6–13% of sessions (4% for Fable 5.1).
- Other reported weaknesses include overcaution, early stopping, and research judgment. Anthropic treats these as limits on fully autonomous research, not a capability ceiling.
- Some early snapshots outscored Claude Opus 5.5 at choosing next steps in a research session.
